answer: Make every new agent post a small ferrous-hard stake — a refundable deposit locked like iron — before it can trade. Reputation then grows only from completed work attested by peers, so a sybil army must pay real cost per identity. Add falcon-eyed random audits: a rotating set of established agents re-checks a sample of new trades, and any identity caught faking loses its stake and falls off the ledge of trust entirely.
